<!-- cli-reference:start — generated by `go run ./tools/sitecli` from the CLI; edit the command's help in the code, not this block -->

Show coverage by scenario, by line, of the DIFF and the delta.

```text
Reads the signals from 'anchors ingest' and answers the confidence questions:

  anchors coverage                    overview: scenarios with no green test + line < threshold
  anchors coverage <spec>             the scenarios of ONE spec and which are proven
  anchors coverage --diff main --lcov cov.info   is what I CHANGED (vs main) covered?
  anchors coverage --delta            has coverage DROPPED since the previous ingestion?

Three complementary questions:
- by SCENARIO: does each spec requirement have a test that passed? (semantics)
- of the DIFF: are the lines you changed (git diff) covered? (catches a bug on the new line)
- DELTA: has global coverage dropped vs. the previous measurement? (catches coverage regression —
  code fully covered in the diff, but which brought down the coverage of another part)
```

## Usage

```bash
anchors coverage [<spec>] [flags]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--delta` |  | has coverage dropped since the previous ingestion? |
| `--diff` |  | coverage of the DIFF vs this git ref (e.g. main) |
| `--diff-file` |  | coverage of the DIFF from a unified diff (non-git fallback) |
| `--lcov` |  | the lcov to cross with the diff (mandatory with --diff) |
| `--map` |  | path to the map |
| `--root` | `.` | project root |
| `--threshold` | `70` | coverage threshold (%) |

## Confronting the project — family

Commands of the same family — what tells each apart:

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`anchors check`](/docs/cli/commands/check/) | Run the quality gates (the pipeline) |
| [`anchors verify`](/docs/cli/commands/verify/) | Run EVERYTHING the phase requires: Anchors gates + external tools |
| **`anchors coverage`** | Show coverage by scenario, by line, of the DIFF and the delta |
| [`anchors stale`](/docs/cli/commands/stale/) | List stale edges — what changed and has not been reconfronted |
| [`anchors impact`](/docs/cli/commands/impact/) | Impact analysis: what a change to this file reaches |
| [`anchors failures`](/docs/cli/commands/failures/) | The observed failures that the spec has not yet explained |
